name: copilot-amplify
description: Extend GitHub Copilot Chat with additional AI model providers
author: Md Mojahid

copilot-amplify.xiaomi.apiKey.markdownDescription: Xiaomi MiMo API Key. Get yours from the [Xiaomi MiMo console](https://www.xiaomimimo.com/). Both Pay-as-you-go (`sk-...`) and Token Plan (`tp-...`) keys are supported.

copilot-amplify.glm.apiKey.markdownDescription: Z.ai GLM API Key. Get yours from the [Z.ai console](https://z.ai/).

copilot-amplify.groq.apiKey.markdownDescription: Groq API Key. Get yours from the [Groq console](https://console.groq.com/).

copilot-amplify.nvidia.apiKey.markdownDescription: NVIDIA NIM API Key. Get yours from the [NVIDIA build site](https://build.nvidia.com/).

copilot-amplify.omniroute.apiKey.markdownDescription: Omniroute Bearer token. Configure the local Omniroute server (default `http://localhost:20128/v1`) with your provider credentials, then enter its API key here.

copilot-amplify.omniroute.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the OmniRoute server, including the `/v1` prefix. Change this if you run OmniRoute on a different host/port.

copilot-amplify.omniroute.noCache.markdownDescription: Send `X-OmniRoute-No-Cache: true` to bypass the semantic cache for every request. Defaults to `false` (caching enabled, so repeated requests hit the cache and cost nothing).

copilot-amplify.omniroute.noMemory.markdownDescription: Send `x-omniroute-no-memory: true` to skip memory + skills injection for every request, avoiding the per-call token/cost overhead. Set to `false` if you want OmniRoute memory and skills to be injected (requires a stable `sessionId` to be useful).

copilot-amplify.omniroute.compression.markdownDescription: Per-request compression override sent via `x-omniroute-compression`. Values: `off`, `default`, `engine:<id>` (e.g. `engine:rtk`), or a named combo id. Leave empty to let OmniRoute pick.

copilot-amplify.omniroute.sessionId.markdownDescription: Caller-supplied session/conversation tag sent via `X-OmniRoute-Session-Id`. It is persisted to `call_logs.session_tag` for per-session cost attribution and feeds memory. Leave empty to let the extension generate one per chat conversation.

copilot-amplify.omniroute.progress.markdownDescription: Send `X-OmniRoute-Progress: true` to opt into progress events from the server.

copilot-amplify.omniroute.modelCacheTtlS.markdownDescription: How long (in seconds) the discovered model list stays cached before refetching `GET /v1/models`.

copilot-amplify.omniroute.logTelemetry.markdownDescription: Log OmniRoute response telemetry (routing decision, provider, latency, tokens, cost, cache hit/cost-saved) to the `Omniroute` output channel. Open it with the `Copilot Amplify: Show Omniroute Telemetry` command.

scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', { force: true })"
